title: 粉色西装男与暗黑剪影

the subject stands upright with a straight posture, shoulders squared, head level, and gaze directed forward toward the camera, wearing large, dark, wraparound-style sunglasses that obscure the eyes, with a neutral facial expression indicated by relaxed brows and closed lips; the hair is light brown and slicked back smoothly, creating a clean, reflective surface with no visible flyaways; the subject wears a pale pink blazer with structured shoulders and sharp lapels over a black, high-neck or turtleneck garment, the blazer fabric appearing smooth and matte with subtle folds along the shoulder and chest, while the black inner layer is flat and non-reflective, providing strong tonal contrast; surrounding the central figure are multiple human silhouettes positioned in the foreground and background, forming a loose semicircle around the subject; these silhouettes are rendered as nearly solid black shapes with minimal visible detail, appearing as upright, suit-wearing forms; two silhouettes stand behind the central figure at shoulder height, slightly left and right, while additional silhouettes occupy the lower foreground, their heads and shoulders partially blocking the lower part of the frame; these surrounding figures are front-facing but remain indistinct, with no facial features visible, creating a layered depth effect with foreground silhouettes, the central subject in the midground, and additional silhouettes in the background; the background itself is a smooth, light gray or off-white plane with no visible texture or environmental context, suggesting a studio-like setting; the camera perspective feels normal to slightly telephoto, compressing the distance between the central figure and the surrounding silhouettes; shadows are soft on the central subject but extremely dense on the silhouettes, creating a high-contrast, graphic effect; subtle specular highlights appear along the hair and the glossy surfaces of the sunglasses;
